R3.method: Measured material volume within the 22.5mm bore cylinder at (0, y, 30)

criteria.condition: Central bore diameter 22.5 mm through the face plate

R3.why: The check only verifies that the bore is empty (material volume < 1.0). In the control run (a 1mm cube), this also passes because there is no material in the bore region. It fails to verify that the hole actually exists through the plate or has the correct diameter; it only checks for a void.

R4.method: Measured diameters of 4 holes at (+-15.5, 30 +- 15.5) via cylinder intersection in plate region

criteria.condition: Four motor screw holes, diameter 3.4 mm

R4.why: The script attempts to find holes by probing with cylinders, but it reports an average diameter of 0.0 on the real part (which has cylindrical faces in the geometry) and fails. The logic for detecting the hole is flawed as it doesn't verify the existence of material around the void.

R5.method: Intersection volume with clearance box [-21.5, 21.5] x [-48, 0] x [8.5, 51.5]

criteria.condition: Motor clearance: nothing in -21.5 <= x <= 21.5, -48 <= y <= 0, 8.5 <= z <= 51.5

R6.method: Checked z_min >= 0 and measured screw hole diameters at (+-25, 25) via vertical void probing

criteria.condition: Two vertical screw holes, diameter 5.5 mm, at (x, y) = (+-25, 25)

R6.why: The screw hole diameter check (vertical void probing) fails on the real part (reporting 0.0) and is not robust. It also doesn't verify that the holes are actually located at the specified (x, y) coordinates effectively, as it relies on a volume threshold that failed on the actual geometry.
